en: Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 16.33. The Triplet on the Cause of Seeing and the Dyad on the Cause The Triplet on the Cause of Seeing (Dassanahetuttika) and the Dyad on the Cause (Hetuduka).
Dependent on a state with a root that is to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state with a root that is not to be abandoned by vision and is not a root, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. In the case of root: sixteen; in the case of object: twelve;
in the case of predominance: thirteen ... pe ... in the case of result: three ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance: sixteen.

Dependent on a state that has roots to be abandoned by vision and is not a root, there arises a state that has no roots to be abandoned by cultivation and is not a root, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of roots … pe … three in the case of resultants … pe … nine in the case of non-disappearance.
